name: directory
title: Archdiocese of New York official parish map (all locations)
command: pnpm diocese roster import new-york directory scratch\directory-research\entries.json
notes: Complete unfiltered official parish map, fetched locally 2026-10-06 (America/New_York). All 326 server-rendered div[data-pf-item] elements imported; page and T3 browser both report 326 locations. No API needed: HTML contains data-id, data-title, data-address, data-website, coordinates, phone, detail URL, tags and schedules. IDs are original numeric CMS data-id values, not invented slugs. Full data-title is the entry name; group is only an explicit title prefix before a colon, not a bulletin-sharing assertion. Kind Church is a roster category, not verification of public Mass. Source street numbers recovered from comma-delimited raw addresses where the display shows only a building name; raw/display addresses retained. County names extracted verbatim from raw address County components, minus suffix; two absent counties not inferred (4802 Pelham, 4024 Gardiner). Websites are directory-supplied, not independently checked; two absent (4688, 4760). Five addresses lack street numbers; four display ZIP instead of city; 4802 also lacks ZIP. All retained with entry notes. Ten entries lack the mass tag; no closure or exclusion inferred. Directory includes separately mapped churches/chapels in merged parishes and repeated display names; 326 sites are not 326 distinct bulletin publishers. Snapshot, extraction script, raw attributes and summary in scratch/directory-research. Roster is a coverage baseline, not evidence of current parish status.
